<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ux_client_script"><sys_ux_client_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><controller_preset/><includes/><macroponent display_value="Customer Insights Default">191743f62f060b50b14f861cbfa4e3fe</macroponent><name>Set Current Context</name><preset/><required_translations>[]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[/**
 * @param {params} params
 * @param {api} params.api
 * @param {any} params.event
 * @param {any} params.imports
 * @param {ApiHelpers} params.helpers
 */
function handler({
    api,
    event,
    helpers,
    imports
}) {
    var text = '';
    var aiSkillOutput = api.data.get_ai_skill_data.output;
    if (aiSkillOutput) {
        if (aiSkillOutput.status == 'success' && aiSkillOutput.response) {
            var skillResponse = aiSkillOutput.response;
            var data = skillResponse.startsWith('{') ?
                JSON.parse(skillResponse) :
                skillResponse;

            var keys = Object.keys(data);
            if (keys.length > 0) {
                var value = data[keys[0]];
                if (typeof value === 'string') {
                    text = value
                        .replace(/</g, '<')
                        .replace(/>/g, '>')
                        .replace(/&/g, '&')
                        .replace(/"/g, '"')
                        .replace(/'/g, "'")
                        .replace(/<[^>]*>/g, '')
                        .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
                        .trim();
                }
            }
        } else if (aiSkillOutput.errorMessage) {
            api.emit('NOW_UXF_PAGE#ADD_NOTIFICATIONS', {
                items: [{
                    'status': 'critical',
                    'icon': 'circle-close-outline',
                    'content': aiSkillOutput.errorMessage,
                    'action': {
                        'type': 'dismiss'
                    }
                }]
            });
        }
    }
    api.setState('skillPayload', {
        'tablename': api.context.props.table,
        'sysid': api.context.props.sysId,
        'currentcontext': text

    });
    if (api.state.queryText && text != api.state.queryText)
        api.setState('isRefreshDisabled', false);
    var triggerProps = {
        'autoTriggerDefaultAction': true
    };
    api.setState('triggerProps', triggerProps);
    api.setState('queryText', text);
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-07-17 02:50:58</sys_created_on><sys_id>291783f62f060b50b14f861cbfa4e310</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Set Current Context</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Pete's Email Engagement Toolkit" source="x_snc_pab_ee_tkit">01900de693acba502e03fde1a903d651</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Pete's Email Engagement Toolkit">01900de693acba502e03fde1a903d651</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_291783f62f060b50b14f861cbfa4e310</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-07-17 02:50:58</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>default</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>
